tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an assessment order for AY 2020‑21 giving effect to the directions issued by the Dispute Resolution Panel. The Order makes additions aggregating to ₹13,38,60,587, which have been adjusted against brought‑forward losses, resulting in a net tax demand of ₹6,61,00,405. The additions are as follows: Interest on inter‑corporate deposits: ₹1,79,06,364 Corporate guarantee fees: ₹11,59,54,223
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Circle 1, LTU Chennai ('DCIT')
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received a Rectification Order dated July 15, 2025, communicated via email on February 25, 2026, from the DCIT. The order allows the carry‑forward of unabsorbed depreciation of ₹70,01,91,586 relating to AY 2017‑18 and grants a deduction of ₹50,00,000, which were not considered in the original assessment. Pursuant to the rectification, the earlier tax demand of ₹6,61,00,405 for AY 2020‑21 has been fully nullified, and a refund of ₹7,09,55,418 has been determined. The matter is currently pending adjudication before the Hon’ble Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT).

Pursuant to this rectification, the earlier tax demand of ₹72,13,53,760 for AY 2022‑23 has been fully nullified.
